title: Message
$comment: Role: the canonical chat message (docs/architecture.md §3.1; ocai/chat/types/message.py) in omit-absent wire form. Parts-only storage: the pre-July-2026 flat `content` field is gone; every turn is `role` + an ordered list of parts (parts.schema.json). Tolerant: unknown members sweep to `extensions` on decode, so additionalProperties stays permissive.
description: A single conversation turn: who spoke (an open role code) and the ordered content parts they produced. The unit every codec encodes/decodes and every conversion edge maps.

role.description: The author's open role code. Known canonical values: user, model (canonical name is model, not assistant — codecs translate), system, tool. Unknown wire roles are LEGAL and preserved verbatim, never coerced to a sentinel.

parts.description: The ordered content parts making up the turn. Always emitted, even when empty — an empty parts list is data, not absence.
